release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob (Build 122 - Hero Speedometer & Scrollable Cockpit).
• Hero Retained Gauge: Prominently centered outside all cards with tachometer/speedometer engine rev animation.
• Dedicated Latency & Socket Card: Large 86dp DSP oscilloscope waveform trace with reticle grid and real-time jitter.
• Technical Specifications Card: Full cluster details (Singapore datacenter, port 8883 SSL, TLS 1.3, ALPN mqtt, synchronized topology).
• Topic Partitions Card: Matches, Lobbies, Presence, Profiles, System with topic slugs and share meters.
• Pinned Action Dock: Refresh and Clean Expired buttons remain permanently docked in place during scrolling.
